programme.desc: It’s Christmas Eve, and Blaze and AJ are helping Santa load his magic bag of presents to deliver all over the world. But Crusher accidently knocks over the bag and sends the presents flying.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Today Darington will attempt his biggest stunt yet: rocketing to the moon! But there's just one problem. His battery-powered rocket is out of energy. To get to the moon Blaze must help Darington recharge his battery.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, Stripes, and AJ are racing through the jungle when Stripes discovers a lost little fire beetle named Sparky. Blaze and his friends set off across the jungle to help Sparky get back home to the top of a red hot volcano.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: There's a fire on the bridge and it's too much for the Fire Chief and his team to handle. They need Firefighting Blaze to help. With time running out, Blaze hurries across town. But can he get to the bridge in time?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Gabby has the perfect tool to get Blaze ready to race: a special remote that can control any machine. But when Crusher takes her remote, he activates machines all over town to slow Blaze down.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Blaze, AJ, and Gabby join Pegwheel the Pirate-Truck for an island treasure hunt! Following their treasure map, the friends search jungle beaches and mountains to find where X marks the spot.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
programme.desc: Crusher’s Grammy is in town to watch Crusher and Blaze race at the Monster Dome. But when Crusher tries to cheat using rocket skis, his plan backfires, blasting him off the racetrack and across Axle City! Part 1

programme.title: Cheers

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
programme.desc: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: La Garçonnière
programme.desc: Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.

programme.title: South Park: Poisson Sanglant
programme.desc: Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

programme.title: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.

programme.title: South Park: Tropicale, Schtropicale
programme.desc: Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.

programme.title: South Park: Combustion Spontanée
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

programme.title: South Park: La Maman de Chef
programme.desc: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek contre Craig
programme.desc: Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jakovasaures
programme.desc: Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
programme.desc: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Orgie de Chat
programme.desc: Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

programme.title: South Park: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi
programme.desc: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park: Les Scouts juifs
programme.desc: Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: Ethernopien dans l'Espace
programme.desc: Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
programme.desc: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

programme.title: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
programme.desc: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

programme.title: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
programme.desc: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
programme.desc: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.
programme.sub-title: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey

programme.title: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
programme.desc: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
programme.sub-title: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: La Petite Fée des Dents
programme.desc: Cartman se réveille et découvre que la fée des dents lui a apporté 2 dollars pour sa dent de lait. Il décide alors de chercher plein de dents pour s'acheter une console.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuple contorsionniste
programme.desc: Le cirque vient d'arriver à South Park. Le numéro des Quintuplés contorsionnistes donne envie aux enfants de faire un numéro.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Lors de l'interro de début de cours, Timmy, un nouvel élève handicapé ne sait pas répondre. Il est alors envoyé chez la principale. Les médecins lui diagnostiquent un déficit aigu de l'attention, qui le prive de devoirs.

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Cet épisode spécial est consacré à Pip, personnage très spécial inspiré d'un roman de Charles Dickens intitulé 'Les Grandes Espérances'. Pip est un jeune forgeron et va devoir trouver une solution pour conquérir le cœur de la belle Estella.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman adhère à la Nambla
programme.desc: Cartman en a marre des autres. Pour lui ils ne sont pas assez matures. Il décide de trouver des amis adultes sur Internet, mais tous ses amis se font envoyer en prison. Il va voir Mephesto pour avoir un ami artificiel.

programme.title: South Park: Tampons en Cheveux de Cherok
programme.desc: Kyle tombe gravement malade, et en ville tout le monde ne jure que par la médecine à base de plantes des indiens. La mère de Kyle refuse alors de faire hospitaliser son fils croyant qu'il ira mieux avec les plantes.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Pète les Plombs
programme.desc: Chef est scandalisé : le drapeau de South Park est selon lui raciste. Afin d'en juger avec la plus grande impartialité, il est demandé aux enfants de décider s'il faut changer ou non le drapeau.

programme.title: South Park: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt
programme.desc: Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.
programme.sub-title: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt

programme.title: South Park: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer?
programme.desc: Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Probablement
programme.desc: Dans l'épisode précédent, les garçons découvrent le Pasteur en plein acte sexuel dans son église. Cartman décide de prendre les choses en main afin de remettre dans le droit chemin tous les enfants de la ville.

programme.title: South Park: CM1
programme.desc: C'est la rentrée. Les garçons arrivent en CM1, heureux de ne plus se faire taper par les grands du CM1. Mais ce sont désormais les CM2 qui les tapent. La nouvelle prof Mme Chrokelpaf, ainsi que la nouvelle façon de travailler les effrayent.

programme.title: South Park: Le Super Classeur
programme.desc: Cartman vient d'acheter un tout nouveau classeur avec toutes les fonctionnalités. C'est alors qu'un homme venu du futur le prévient que ce classeur peut envahir la planète. Le classeur est donc détruit, mais Cartman s'en rachète un le lendemain.

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami hatches a plan to save Lily's father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue mission.
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami's knowledge of the sea may be the key to escaping this scrum alive!
programme.sub-title: Z’s Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Shuzo's squad of manned torpedoes targets the Straw Hats and the giants! The crazed captain tests Luffy's mettle in a showdown on land, but the wily pirate pulls off a supersized surprise in hopes to stomp out the madman for good

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!
programme.sub-title: Arriving! A Burning Island – Punk Hazard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Zoro put their strength to the ultimate test in a battle with a dragon. Meanwhile, a band of mysterious intruders make their gassy presence felt aboard the Sunny!
programme.sub-title: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. the Giant Dragon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!
programme.sub-title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai’s Horrifying Severed Head!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance on a body-less Samurai!
programme.sub-title: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami's soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!
programme.sub-title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!
programme.sub-title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy's group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami's group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!
programme.sub-title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-Cold Lake!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Luffy and his mates race toward a reunion, Admiral Smoker struggles to survive a heart-stopping showdown with Trafalgar Law!
programme.sub-title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew – and the loss of his extra legs – quickly dampens the captain's enthusiasm!
programme.sub-title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard's mysterious transformation!
programme.sub-title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Toriko, Luffy, and Goku's three-way tie in the World's Best Eating Competition, the festivities are interrupted by the sudden appearance of a monster that threatens to consume every living thing on earth.
programme.sub-title: History’s Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!
programme.sub-title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
programme.sub-title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky – still trapped in Chopper's Body – makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
programme.sub-title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
programme.sub-title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
programme.sub-title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy's battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob – and the evil genius who created the monster!
programme.sub-title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats make a valiant push to capture Caesar Clown - Luffy matches his Armament Haki with Clown's powerful Gas-Gas Fruit powers! The battle turns in favor of the Straw Hats, but underestimating Clown's abilities may have deadly consequences!
programme.sub-title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Trafalgar Law finds trouble in the form of an old acquaintance, Chopper investigates the Master's lab, and the mysterious Samurai shows what he can do with a full body!
programme.sub-title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'emon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Master gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are finally revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island!
programme.sub-title: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children, Chopper plots a daring escape attempt, and the Master markets his greatest weapon!
programme.sub-title: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close In!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: A desperate need for candy leads the children to return to the lab, and Caesar plans to show the world the new and improved version of Smiley!
programme.sub-title: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the Straw Hats find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of purple gas that turns everything living thing in its path into petrified statues of ash!

programme.sub-title: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law’s Great Escape!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marissa, 22, says her family treated her like an outcast in childhood & she later began working as an escort to make ends meet. Marissa faces family for the first time in 3 years on Dr. Phil's stage. Did they indeed reject her & is there hope for repair?
programme.sub-title: I Am The Outcast Of My Family And They Threw Me Away Like Trash!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shaela went from being a mom to two with a master's degree working as a school counselor to being unemployed & living in an RV. Mom Sandra says Shaela has exhibited strange behaviors, including trimming bushes & pulling weeds in the middle of the night.
programme.sub-title: My Daughter Went From Being A School Counselor With A Master's Degree To Losing Her Children & Living In An RV

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In one of the most bizarre love stories to come across Dr. Phil’s stage, now Dr. Phil uncovers a massive secret that changes everything with Ryan and Suzanne. Here is the conclusion to a fascinating tale of lies, deception and emotional extortion! Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Questionable Will & A Suspect Twin: Is This The Craziest Catfish Story Of Them All Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with Angie & Hannah who say step-father & step-grandfather Ralph routinely sexually abused them. For the first time in 15 years, Angie & Hannah are face-to-face with Ralph, who denies all claims. Is Ralph cleared by a polygraph test?
programme.sub-title: Did Step-Dad Molest His Step-Daughter And Granddaughter? The Polygraph Results Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil's guests say they are ready to run for the hills! Meet Kelly, who calls herself a runaway bride, and Chad, who says weddings are too expensive. Can Dr. Phil get them to commit?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Shelby wants to find the truth about her dad's online relationship with a woman he's never met. Dad David says "Maria" has a $10 million inheritance and says he knows for a fact that "Maria" is a real person and he can't wait to introduce her one day.
programme.sub-title: My Dad Believes He's Married To A Woman Named "Maria" He's Never Met Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Facebook, unexpected things happen, like reuniting with a loved one or being fired after posting an inappropriate photograph. It can also be a lifesaver, offering a human connection when all seems lost. Dr. Phil delves into a story that made headlines.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A recent study shows that the number of men and women having extramarital affairs is on the rise. Could your spouse be cheating on you? Dr. Phil's guests are struggling with the aftermath of infidelity.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues with pregnant teen, Sara, who says she’s not addicted--her sister is a bad influence. Dr. Phil learns she and sister Sadie did cocaine the night before the show. Dr. Phil shows video of addicted babies and issues an ultimatum. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Pregnant And Abusing Drugs: The Ultimatum Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brad says he is in a bitter custody battle with ex Kimberly, who's kept him from seeing their three kids. Kimberly says Brad is unstable & irresponsible and until he cleans up his act, he can't see their kids. Can these exes learn to peacefully co-parent?
programme.sub-title: My Ex Is Evil: I Want To See My Kids

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping two-part series, Dr. Phil sits down with a family torn apart over accusations of the unthinkable. Melody says her 4-year-old granddaughter revealed that she was touched inappropriately by a man in a mask, and that the man was her daddy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A father pleads for help regarding his missing daughter. Gabby Petito, 22, set off on a van trip with her fiancé, but two months later he returned alone. Police revealed the couple had an incident--caught on camera. Gabby's dad is determined to find her.
programme.sub-title: Missing "Van Life" Woman's Father Speaks Out: The Dr. Phil Interview Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you think of negotiations, corporate boardrooms come to mind but really it happens every day in your own house. Learn the principles of making a deal, how to compromise to get what you want, plus five things you might not realize you can bargain for!
programme.sub-title: Lazy Husbands & Cling-On Kids/Unemployed & Under Fire

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heroin use among America's youth is plaguing some of the most prestigious & safest suburban towns. Dr. Phil sheds light on Simi Valley, CA, where residents are fighting a heroin epidemic. Dr. Phil talks to teens., parents & meets with Mayor Bob Huber.
programme.sub-title: Heroin In Suburbia: A Town Intervention

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can married people be friends with someone of the opposite sex without sex getting in the way? At what point does a friendly relationship become an affair of the heart or emotional infidelity? Meet Randy, who says his wife, Amanda, has crossed that line.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 18, says she is tired of her mom butting into her love life with boyfriend Eric. Mom Courtney says it's because Brooklyn's boyfriend has two children & a wife! Eric's wife, Mandy, wants Brooklyn to leave her husband alone & she'll fight for him.
programme.sub-title: My Boyfriend Is Married & His Wife Is Irrelvant To Me

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 2011, Morgan, 20, was found dead, a suspected overdose with a later ruling of death by suicide. Parents Toni & Steve believe something more sinister: she was stalked, tormented & killed by Brooke, 18, who joins the show with her dad, Jim.
programme.sub-title: Dr. Phil Mystery: Was Morgan Murdered By Stalkers?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gayle says her soon-to-be daughter-in-law, Hannah, is manipulative, immoral and disrespectful and she’s never even met her! Gayle claims Hannah's relationship with her son, Ryan, is based on sin. See what happens when Gayle and Hannah meet with Dr. Phil!
programme.sub-title: My Son Picked The Wrong Fiancee

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil goes into his mailbag to answer viewers' popular questions! He has help from commedienne and author Teresa Strasser. When Teresa talks to moms on the street, find out their biggest parenting and pregnancy queries. Update on Ted Williams.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mark & ex-wife, Melissa, say daughter, Malia, 17, has been running away since age 13, a 6th grade school drop out, & has become physically abusive. They say 2 years ago she became involved with a 35-year-old man & they fear she'll end up dead.
programme.sub-title: Our Runaway Teen Daughter Thinks She's In Love With An Older Man Who Police Allege Raped And Threatened Her

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Learning your spouse is a cheater is devastating, but how do you recover when his lover is also your best friend? This young couple was newlyweds when she found him in bed with her best friend and bridesmaid. He says he loves both--can Dr. Phil help?

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony explores a few of the many faces of Miami. Chef Michelle Bernstein takes Tony out to an authentic Cuban breakfast and a late-night dinner at a gas station café in Doral.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown, we first visit the city of Glasgow, then we head north into the Scottish Highlands.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: For the first time, Tony visits Budapest, 25 years after democracy planted its flag –alongside the Oscar-winning master of light, cinematographer Vilmos Zsigmond, as one of his key guides.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: A country of only six million people where a vast percentage of the land is steaming hot jungle or a huge scrub desert known simply as The Chaco. This is one of the least known nations in the world.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony seeks to challenge his notions of Mississippi by taking a road trip to meet a cast of Mississippians enjoying the diverse foodways and embracing the traditional and contemporary music worlds.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
